subject: Application for Graduate Civil Engineer / Concrete Field Technician, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer / Concrete Field Technician role at K&H Geotechnical Services that I saw on SEEK, and I am sending it to the address on your careers page.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

The chance to train in NATA field and laboratory testing on major tunnel projects is what drew me to this role. My course covered AS 1289 and AS 1726, but I have not done materials testing on a job yet, so the training you offer matters to me. I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney.

Would you be open to a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Graduate Civil Engineer / Concrete Field Technician
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer / Concrete Field Technician role advertised on SEEK. A field role with structured training in soil, aggregate and concrete testing on Sydney tunnel projects is the kind of start I am looking for.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. My course covered earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and the standards I studied included AS 1289 and AS 1726 for soil testing and geotechnical site investigation.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I carried out site inspections and quality checks, kept material records and wrote site and progress reports, which is close to the daily logs and test reports this role asks for.

I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I live in Melton and am open to discussing relocation to Sydney. I have not done materials testing on a job yet, so I would value the NATA training you offer.
Thank you for considering my application. Some of my course drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
